verdict.rationale: Mailgun's first-party docs describe Inbound Parsing that routes incoming domain mail to your application, plus Route rules for handling incoming messages and receiving in US/EU regions. A community user calls it the best inbound handling available because rules apply before messages reach your servers, and another describes years of using inbound routing. One user reports inbound is no longer available on the free plan, a plan-tier caveat. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of MX record setup, explicit detail on which parsed fields (headers, body, attachments) are posted to the webhook or API, and inbound on the free plan.
